card.description: Zaziel is a towering operative of the Root Access Authority, a figure of ancient mysticism fused with advanced technology. He stands on a jagged peak beneath swirling storm clouds, his silhouette framed by floating holographic windows of cascading green code. Zaziel wears a basalt and obsidian headdress adorned with pulsing crystalline glyphs, a hammered bronze cuirass etched with Ethiopian hieroglyphs, and a carbon‑fiber lattice overlay. In his hand he holds a glowing green data crystal (ROOT_KEY) that interfaces with the Admin Windows. A sniper‑view HUD overlays the scene, marking him as TARGET_ID: ZAZIEL.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Robust, muscular frame clad in layered armor—hammered bronze cuirass, obsidian pauldrons, and a carbon‑fiber lattice weave that flexes with movement.
**Face/Sensors:** Half‑mask of polished obsidian with bio‑luminescent glyphs, ocular sensor array that glows faintly green, reflecting the holographic code.
**Clothing/Armor:** Basalt headdress with embedded crystalline glyphs, bronze cuirass etched in Ethiopian script, obsidian shoulder plates, and a carbon‑fiber lattice overlay that refracts light.

**Key Features:** Pulsing crystalline glyphs on headdress and armor, green data crystal emitting a soft glow, floating holographic windows of cascading green code, storm clouds swirling overhead, sniper HUD overlay.
evolution: Phase 1 (Unaugmented): Zaziel in standard operational gear—bronze cuirass, obsidian pauldrons, minimal tech, data crystal dormant.
Phase 2 (Augmented): After receiving ROOT_KEY, armor glows, glyphs intensify, data crystal emits bright green light, holographic code streams more densely.
props: Item: Data Crystal (ROOT_KEY) – a translucent green crystal that channels forbidden code.
Item: Obsidian Staff with Glyphs – a ceremonial staff that doubles as a data conduit.
